**6-Month Data Science Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1-2 weeks | EDX2045 | Introduction to Python and Programming for Data Science and Machine Learning | edx | Foundational programming skills in Python are essential for data science. This course covers the basics of Python programming, including data types, control flow, and functions. |
| 2-4 weeks | EDX2052 | Introduction to Data Science with Python | edx | Building on the Python skills learned in the previous course, this course introduces data science concepts, including data cleaning, visualization, and machine learning. |
| 4-6 weeks | EDX3425 | Data Science with Python | edx | This course delves deeper into data science with Python, covering topics such as k-means clustering, machine learning, and statistical learning theory. |
| 6-8 weeks | EDX873 | Analyzing Data with Python | edx | This course focuses on data analysis with Python, covering topics such as data cleaning, manipulation, and visualization. |
| 8-10 weeks | EDX3095 | Predictive Analytics: Basic Modeling Techniques | edx | This course introduces predictive analytics, including machine learning algorithms and model evaluation. |
| 10-12 weeks | EDX207 | Machine Learning with Python: from Linear Models to Deep Learning | edx | This course covers advanced machine learning topics, including linear models, kernel machines, and neural networks. |
| 12-14 weeks | EDX2509 | Data Science: Wrangling | edx | This course focuses on data wrangling, including data cleaning, transformation, and visualization. |
| 14-18 weeks | EDX1226 | Data Science: Capstone | edx | This course is a capstone project that allows learners to apply their data science skills to a real-world problem. |
| 18-24 weeks | EDX3352 | Machine Learning: Practical Applications | edx | This course covers practical applications of machine learning, including regression, classification, and dimension reduction. |

This learning path starts with foundational programming skills in Python, followed by data science concepts, and then delves deeper into data science with Python, data analysis, predictive analytics, and machine learning. The capstone project allows learners to apply their skills to a real-world problem, and the final course covers practical applications of machine learning. This path provides a comprehensive education in data science, covering both theoretical and practical aspects.
